construction_controls.scope: Generated arrays/files exercise actual private source scoring seam; no original full candidate execution.

implementation.budget_scope: Separate caller-declared source/submission/reference reads, request counts, working-memory admission and output byte caps. Parent scheduler owns actual wall/process-memory enforcement.
implementation.candidate_identity: Matches operator-supplied freeze and condition; cannot prove the candidate produced the submitted values.
implementation.permitted_request_export: One source fold only; no query targets, references, otherfold packets or private outputs. Export is not an OS isolation boundary.
implementation.private_products: Complete per-job targets/predictions/qids/time rows/correlations/foldmetadata and identities retained privately; no digest-only scoring claim.
implementation.raw_submissions_checked: Ordered manifest/index/NPY identities, exact privately regenerated requests, primitive shape/extent/finiteness, bounded stable ordinary files, streaming exact inventory.

remaining_limits: Protected fresh per-fold candidate execution/delivery remains unqualified. The existing70episode nativeengine cannot dispatch this source schedule unchanged.
Packets for different folds must never be co-exposed or preserve candidate state: their training targets can reveal held-out responses.
Authoring/exposure histories, actualcandidate execution traces and common A/B delivery budgets are not established by artifact hash checks.
No original-source candidate campaign, neural fitting or independent AI reproduction occurred.
Full private observation products require a separately reviewed authentic-run storage/compute allocation; generated controls do not measure those costs.
Historical preprocessing/PCA/readout numerical parity and579-to567 cross-representation identity remain unqualified.
Continuous discrepancies and paired source-score deltas are distinct from binary equivalence or meaningful superiority; no tolerance or p-value-gain rule is invented.

source_semantics.prediction_requests: Variable original uniqueqid count per job; never substituted by70 purged episodes.
source_semantics.predictor_seam: Operator-provided train_x/train_y/query_x/context -> frozen raw prediction matrix; no query targets in request.
source_semantics.private_math: Unchanged original-inputs-v1 predict_job/compute_session and pooled np.corrcoef; all source lag/layer/control fields retained.
source_semantics.reference_math: Unchanged original-inference-v1 full3b/c/d/e family and original-figure3-v1 fullpanel discrepancies/14session paired deltas.
source_semantics.source_precision: Original input/source panel float64; raw submitted predictions permit finitefloat32/64 and are assigned into the sourcefloat64 prediction buffer.
source_semantics.source_support: Missing/nonfinite raw predictions fail; undefined Pearson correlations propagate; matched defined-support diagnostics retained.
